title: feat(plugin-search): add fuzzy subsequence matcher and ranker

reviews.body:
Code review summary:

The fuzzy matcher change looks reasonable overall. The implementation is isolated as pure helpers, exported from `plugin-search`, documented in the package README, and covered with focused tests for subsequence matching, ranking, case sensitivity, empty query behavior, word/camel boundaries, limits, and repeated-character input. I also ran `pnpm --filter @floatboat/nexus-plugin-search exec tsc --noEmit` locally and TypeScript passed.

A couple of verification notes:

- I could not complete `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` because the current branch/base has an existing lockfile mismatch in `packages/plugin-toolbar/package.json` vs `pnpm-lock.yaml`; this does not appear to be introduced by this PR.
- Running Vitest/tsup locally was blocked by a local Rollup native optional dependency loading/signature issue on macOS arm64, before tests executed.

Main remaining blocker is non-code: CLA assistant still reports `license/cla` as pending / not signed. Please sign the CLA (or trigger the CLA recheck if already signed) before this can be merged. Once CLA is green, this looks OK from the code review side.
